name: chat-approval
title: Approval card
description: The agent waits to read or change a file or run a command until the person answers: the kind of change and the time left (none when the request has no time limit: it says it waits for the person), the question, the path or command exactly, a preview, risks and paths, then the answers its request lists (Allow once, Allow for this session, Allow for this folder) and Deny (nclite's ApprovalAsk). Settled, one line says how.

files.core: approval-core.ts (APPROVAL_CHOICES, choicesFor, approvalView, outcomeOf, timeLeft, msLeft; no DOM)

attributes.data-answer: idle | sending | error; aria-busy while sending

methods.show(entry, open, now): draws the card; `open` while the feed still waits on it
methods.tick(now): keeps the time left current; past it the card is drawn lapsed
methods.setPhase(phase, message?): sending ignores further clicks (answer-once); error shows why

events: chat-answer (bubbles): detail { approvalId, answer: { approved, scope? } }, raised once
whenNotToUse: Board decisions (acknowledge, drop): those are the person's clicks on the cards.
accessibility: A named group; every answer is a real button with its words; Deny sits apart from the allows. The preview scrolls and takes focus.
